class.name: TamaContext
class.brief_description: Base class for providing runtime context values to TamaScript expressions.
class.description:
[b]TamaContext[/b] is a [RefCounted] object that TamaScript expressions can call to read live game state. The built-in implementation provides [method time] and [method get_1_in]; extend this class in GDScript or C++ to expose additional values.
Assign a custom instance via [method TamaManager.set_context] before any emitters start.
[b]Example — custom context:[/b] [codeblock] class MyContext extends TamaContext: func time() -> float: return Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
func _ready(): TamaManager.set_context(MyContext.new()) [/codeblock]
TamaScript can then use [code]time()[/code] inside expressions: [codeblock] dir abs sin(time()) * 90 [/codeblock]

method.name: time
method.description: Returns a time value (in seconds) available to TamaScript expressions as [code]time()[/code]. The default implementation returns 0; override in a subclass to provide [code]Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0[/code] or any other clock.

method.name: get_1_in
method.description: Returns 1 with probability [code]1/n[/code], otherwise 0. Used in TamaScript expressions as [code]get_1_in(n)[/code] for random fire conditions. The default implementation uses a uniform random number.
